document_id: Krausmann 2014 - STREST report on lessons learned from recent catastrophic events

impacts.description: The fires and explosions at the Cosmo Oil refinery led to the evacuation of 1,142 residents.

evidence.quote: The fires and explosions at the Cosmo Oil refinery led to the evacuation of 1,142 residents.

impacts.description: At the refinery, 6 injuries (1 severe, 5 minor) were recorded while at a facility adjacent to the LPG tank farm, where a fire was triggered via a domino effect, 3 persons suffered injuries, one of them severe.

evidence.quote: At the refinery, 6 injuries (1 severe, 5 minor) were recorded while at a facility adjacent to the LPG tank farm, where a fire was triggered via a domino effect, 3 persons suffered injuries, one of them severe

impacts.description: The refinery's LPG storage tank farm was completely destroyed, as well as surrounding pipelines and roads.

evidence.quote: The refinery's LPG storage tank farm was completely destroyed, as well as surrounding pipelines and roads (Fig. 2.1).

impacts.description: Adjacent asphalt tanks were damaged due to debris impact, and fires broke out in two neighbouring petrochemical facilities.

evidence.quote: Adjacent asphalt tanks were damaged to due debris impact, and fires broke out in two neighbouring petrochemical facilities.

impacts.description: In addition, damage to glass windows, vehicles, marine vessels and other structures was observed.

evidence.quote: In addition, damage to glass windows, vehicles, marine vessels and other structures was observed (Cosmo Oil, 2011a).

impacts.description: The fires at the refinery caused Cosmo Oil to declare a loss on disaster of over 5.7 billion ¥ (72 million US$ 1) for fiscal year 2010, which ended on 31 March, 2011.

evidence.quote: The fires at the refinery caused Cosmo Oil to declare a loss on disaster of over 5.7 billion ¥ (72 million US$ 1) for fiscal year 2010, which ended on 31 March, 2011 (Cosmo Oil, 2011b).

impacts.description: For fiscal year 2011, the company reported a net deficit of 9.1 billion ¥ (114 million US$) which was mostly due to the suspension of activities at the Chiba refinery and associated alternative supply costs.

evidence.quote: For fiscal year 2011, the company reported a net deficit of 9.1 billion ¥ (114 million US$) which was mostly due to the suspension of activities at the Chiba refinery and associated alternative supply costs (Cosmo Oil, 2012).

impacts.description: Overall, the refinery suffered a 2-year business interruption due to the damage caused by the Tohoku earthquake.

evidence.quote: Overall, the refinery suffered a 2-year business interruption due to the damage caused by the Tohoku earthquake (Cosmo Oil, 2013).

impacts.description: The explosions damaged nearby asphalt tanks due to debris impact, causing asphalt to leak into the ocean.

evidence.quote: The explosions damaged nearby asphalt tanks due to debris impact, causing asphalt to leak into the ocean (Cosmo Oil, 2011a).

impacts.description: In addition, dispersion of flammable LPG vapours and burning missile projection from the explosions started fires in two neighbouring chemical facilities, with subsequent hazardous-materials releases.

evidence.quote: In addition, dispersion of flammable LPG vapours and burning missile projection from the explosions started fires in two neighbouring chemical facilities, with subsequent hazardous-materials releases (Krausmann and Cruz, 2013).
